verses.1: As Adonai Yehovah said: The inner door of the courtyard will be closed for six days after it is built. On Shabbat, it will be opened again. And on the first day of the new month, it will be opened once more.
verses.2: And the priest came through the door. But the door was open, and he stood on the threshold of the door. The priests completed their rituals and offerings. Then he bowed down at the entrance of the door, and he left. The door remained open until morning.
verses.3: And they shall worship the people of the earth at the gates of that city on the Sabbath days and in the holidays, before Jehovah.
verses.4: And the offerings that the priest brings to Jehovah on the Sabbath day shall be six whole, unblemished golden bowls, and pure lambs’ meat.
verses.5: And a sacrifice for the sea and for the birds… A sacrifice of hands and wine for that place.
verses.6: And on the new day, there will be fresh bread, six days of fresh fruit, and fresh fish.
verses.7: And where shall the sheep be, and where shall the lambs be? They will be used as food for the people. And the honey will be given to them, just as their hands will find it.
verses.8: And when the king comes, he will go through the door. But he will also go along his own path.
verses.9: And when the people of the land come before Jehovah in the assemblies that are held at the gate of Zion, they go through the gate of Negev. And when they come through the gate of Negev, they go through the gate of Zion. They do not return through the same gate by which they came, for they have seen it.
verses.10: And the priest shall be with them when they come in, and when they go out.
verses.11: And on the festivals and holidays, the offerings will be given where the sheep and goats are, and also to the priests. The wine will also be given there.
verses.12: And when the priest performs his rituals, whether they are offerings of grain or other offerings to God, he opens the back door first. Then he performs his rituals as is done on the Day of Repentance. After that, he closes the door again.
verses.13: And Kebes, son of Shannat, will do this for the sake of Jehovah. In the morning, he will carry out this task.
verses.14: And a sacrifice shall be offered for him in the morning, on the day of the Sabbath. On that day, one-third of the honey will be used to make an offering to God. These laws shall be eternal.
verses.15: They will prepare the bread, the wine, and the oil in the morning. It’s always a time of celebration.
verses.16: Thus said Adonai YHWH: “When the ruler is given a reward, it belongs to his descendants. Their inheritance will be theirs; they will have control over it.”
verses.17: And if one of his servants were to receive a portion from his inheritance, and that portion would continue to belong to him until the age of seventy. But his inheritance would then go to his sons.
verses.18: And the ruler shall not take from the people their inheritance, so that they may keep it under his control. He shall also not give away his children to others, so that my people may not be separated from their inheritance.
verses.19: And he led me through the door, along the walls of the holy place, to where the priests stood. There, in the courtyard, there was a place where people could rest for the night.
verses.20: And he said to me, “This is the place where the priests will carry out their rituals. It’s also the place where they will punish the sins that have been committed. They will keep the offerings separate from the rest of the offerings, so that the people can be sanctified.”
verses.21: And he led me to the outer courtyard. He took me to the four corners of the courtyard. There, I saw a courtyard within the boundaries of the courtyard itself.
verses.22: In each of the four corners of the courtyard, there are courtyards with dimensions of forty in length and thirty in width. Each of these courtyards is divided into four equal parts.
verses.23: And around them were walls surrounding them all four sides. They were made of stone, built beneath the towers.
verses.24: And he said to me, “These are the houses of those who worship there. The servants in those houses offer sacrifices to the people.”
